humanReadable.title: DevExtreme grid and Spreadsheet local POC
humanReadable.overview: The local POC is complete and independently verified. It includes corrected variable-drop behavior, bounded DataGrid import validation, and a reproducible Spreadsheet production work-session procedure. No durable shared knowledge changed.
delivered: The Angular DataGrid POC supports typed-variable drop behavior and rejects XLSX imports containing populated cells beyond its seven-column model.

The genuine DevExpress Spreadsheet host resolves visible pointer drops without a fixed active-cell distance, preserves the original selection, and documents a Release production upload, edit, drop, download, and XLSX reopen roundtrip.
